a.name: Question index
a.description: The thirteen H2 questions word for word in the display face, numbered in page order, as ruled rows under one steel rule; four and a disclosure on phones.
a.differs_from: The index is the page's own questions, ruled, with no card, photo or band; London's pick is a photo beside arrow rows in a sunk panel and PageNav is an unheaded row of pills.

b.name: Icon rows
b.description: A raised card: the sections as line-icon rows divided by rules in two columns, a settled Manchester puppy filling the card's right column from 640px.
b.differs_from: A raised card with the photo on the right and icon rows that say what kind of section each is; London's pick puts the photo left in a sunk panel with plain arrow rows.

c.name: Stage rows
c.description: Three page-order stages as rows on the steel band: numeral and name, four ruled links, the enquiry as a brass pill; one stage and a disclosure on phones.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, layout: London's three equal stage columns become three stage rows of four page-order sections, with the enquiry as a closing pill. Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
